name: Vokal
about: O‘z diapazoningizda notalar bilan raspevkalar — jo‘rnavozlik va ovoz chizig‘i bilan; diapazon va ovoz turini tekshirish; dron ustida vokaliz improvizatsiyasi
tipPhones: Quloqchinda kuylash yaxshiroq: ilova pianinoni emas, ovozni eshitadi
micDenied: Mikrofonga ruxsat yo‘q — ovoz chizig‘i ko‘rinmaydi
prog.title: Dasturlar
ftr.extra: Qulay diapazondan necha yarim ton yuqori va pastga chiqish. Ehtiyotkorlik bilan, zo‘riqmasdan. Bo‘shashtirish har doim qulay qismda.
ftr.listen: Ovoz faqat shu qurilmada tahlil qilinadi va yozib olinmaydi.
ftr.guide: Past kuy notalarni ushlashga yordam beradi. Quloqchinda ilova faqat ovozni eshitadi.
v.title: Ovoz diapazoni
v.none: Diapazon hali tekshirilmagan — hozircha mashqlar ovoz turiga ko‘ra:
v.disclaimer: Har kimning ovozi o‘ziga xos. Bu yerdagi tur — diapazon bo‘yicha mo‘ljal, hukm emas: uni pedagog tembr va qulay zona bo‘yicha aniqroq belgilaydi.
v.adj: Chetni tanlab ‹ › bilan suring yoki chiziq bo‘ylab barmoq bilan torting
test.low: Sekin pastga, xirillamasdan olinadigan eng past notagacha kuylang. Har birini ushlang.
test.high: Endi eng balandigacha — baqirmasdan va zo‘riqmasdan, falsetto ham bo‘ladi.
test.few: Notalar juda kam — har birini ushlab, yana kuylang
im.hint: Dron ustida vokaliz bilan improvizatsiya qiling. Ovoz chizig‘i rangli: yashil — pog‘onaga aniq, sariq — yaqin, qizil — laddan tashqari. Lad — qo‘lda yoki «Avto».
how.breath: In through the nose for 4 counts, hold, then a long even “s”. Shoulders stay down, the belly moves in slowly.
how.pulse: Short pushes of air on “f”: the belly works, the throat is free.
how.trill5: Relaxed lips vibrate (“brr”) and the sound never stops. If it won't come, support the cheeks lightly with fingers.
how.trillOct: Glide an octave up and back on a trill, with no steps between registers.
how.hum: Lips closed, teeth apart; the “m” buzzes in the lips and nose. Quiet and easy.
how.straw: Sing “oo” into a straw or through rounded lips: easy on the throat, an even sound.
how.ng: The back of the tongue meets the palate, as at the end of “sing”. A light sound downwards.
how.tongue: A rolled “r” on the triad. If it won't come, use a lip trill.
how.siren5: A smooth glide on “oo”, with no steps.
how.siren8: Glide an octave up and back; soft through the register change, no jolt.
how.sigh: A light “hah” from the top down, like a sigh of relief: it releases tension.
how.ma5: Soft lips, a freely open mouth, an even sound on every note.
how.mimema: The vowels change, the placement stays; a light “m”.
how.vowels: A-e-i-o-u on one pitch: an even timbre, a calm larynx.
how.nu: Come down with a light head voice — carry the top quality down.
how.yo: A soft “y” on every note, a round vowel.
how.arp8: 1-3-5-8-5-3-1 on “ah”: take the top lightly, without a push.
how.arp10: “Mee-ah” up to the tenth: a wide span on one breath.
how.oct: The top note lightly and at once, no scoop from below.
how.rossini: Nine notes up and down in eighths on one breath — light and nimble.
how.agile5: Fast and clear, every note heard. Slow the tempo in the settings if needed.
how.turn: Small notes light, the vowel stays the same.
how.ha135: Short notes from a push of the belly; the throat stays out of it.
how.haArp: Precise short notes, each starting at once, without a scoop.
how.messa: One note: soft — louder — soft. Pitch and timbre stay the same.
how.thirds: Moves in thirds on “lah”: hit every note precisely.
how.fifths: Pure fifths: listen to the chord and sit inside it.
how.chrom: Semitones up and down — small precise steps.
how.minor5: The third is lower: hear the minor chord.
how.bra: Fast clear diction, the sound never stops.
how.coolHum: Quiet and soft downwards — the voice rests after work.
how.coolTrill: A light lip trill from the top down.
how.yawn: Like a yawn: a free larynx, the sound slides down.
ftr.sched: Vokal mashg‘ulotlari kunlari va vaqti — xohlasa har kuni; eslatma «Vokal» nomi bilan keladi
help.what: O‘z diapazoningizda notalar bilan raspevkalar, diapazon va ovoz turini tekshirish, dron ustida improvizatsiya.
help.1: Mashq eng past qulay notadan eng balandigacha va qaytib boradi; har qadamdan oldin akkord, kuylash ostida — tonika.
help.2: Yuqorida — qadam notalari bo‘g‘inlar bilan, pastda — balandlik chizig‘i: maqsad notalar va ovoz chizig‘i. Surish — keyingi mashq.
help.3: «Ovoz» — ishchi va jismoniy diapazon hamda ovoz turi; chetlari barmoq bilan suriladi. Diapazonsiz mashqlar boshlanmaydi.
help.4: «Improvizatsiya» — tonikada o‘z droni; ovoz chizig‘i aniqlik bo‘yicha rangli, lad — qo‘lda yoki «Avto».
help.tip: Quloqchinda kuylash yaxshiroq: ilova pianinoni emas, ovozni eshitadi.
noSound: Ovoz hali tayyor emas — ekranga tegib, qaytadan urinib ko‘ring
need.title: Avval — ovoz diapazoni
need.text: Mashqlar diapazoningiz bo‘yicha tuziladi. Tekshiruv bir daqiqa: chegaragacha pastga, chegaragacha yuqoriga va odatdagidek bir oz kuylang.
need.manual: Yoki ovoz turi bo‘yicha belgilang, chetlarini keyin tuzating:
need.typeSet: Diapazon tur bo‘yicha belgilandi — chetlarini tuzatish mumkin
v.explain: Ishchi — ovoz ishonchli yangraydigan joy. Jismoniy — ovoz baqirmasdan va zo‘riqmasdan oladigan, lekin hali noqulay notalar. Mashqlar ular orasidagi o‘sish zonasiga kiradi va ishchi diapazonni jismoniyga qarab kengaytiradi.
test.work: Odatdagidek qulay kuylang: gammani yuqoriga va pastga yoki sevimli jumlani, 15 soniyacha.
im.autoHint: Lad kuylanganiga ko‘ra aniqlanadi: qaysi pog‘onada qancha vaqt
ftr.grow: Mashqlar ishchi diapazondan jismoniyga qarab qanchalik chiqadi. Ehtiyotkorlik bilan: baqirmasdan va zo‘riqmasdan. Bo‘shashtirish har doim ishchi diapazonda.
pr.title: Rivojlanish
pr.empty: Bu yerda kunlar bo‘yicha rivojlanish paydo bo‘ladi: aniqlik, qanchalik balandga chiqildi, kuylash vaqti. O‘zi yoziladi — mashqlar, improvizatsiya va «Kuylash»dagi qo‘shiqlardan keyin.
pr.chart: Kunlar bo‘yicha rivojlanish: kuylangan diapazon va aniqlik
pr.sugHi: Oxirgi uch mashg‘ulotda ishchi yuqoridan toza baland olindi. Ishchini {n} gacha kengaytiraylikmi?
pr.sugLo: Oxirgi uch mashg‘ulotda ishchi pastdan toza past olindi. Ishchini {n} gacha kengaytiraylikmi?
sing.openHint: Mediateka → «Kuylash»: minus, kuy, ovoz chizig‘i va har dubl uchun hisob
